## Summary of Results

Jonathan Bailey, the star of "Wicked," has been named People magazine's Sexiest Man Alive for 2025. The announcement was made Monday night on "The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon." 

Bailey succeeds John Krasinski, who held the title in 2024. Bailey is notably the first openly gay man to be named People magazine's Sexiest Man Alive in the title's 40-year history.

He is known for his role as Lord Anthony Bridgerton on Netflix's "Bridgerton" and earned a 2024 Emmy nomination for his work in the Showtime series "Fellow Travelers." Bailey expressed his gratitude for the honor, saying it was "a huge honor" and that he was "incredibly flattered," though he also noted the title was "completely absurd."
